action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: Map marker SVG icons were blocking pointer events, making markers unclickable. This was introduced by the refactor when switching from innerHTML to safe DOM construction in buildIconSvgElement(). Fixed by adding 'pointer-events: none' to .mmm-marker-medallion svg in App.css. All other refactored features working correctly. Backend stats test validation needs update (expects 7 districts, actual is 10).
